content:
deploy-bot: Built hotfix image: registry.redwood/inference/pool-guard:hotfix-2026-03-24-d9e7

deploy-bot: Starting canary in dedicated-us-east-2 (5%). Monitor 10m. UI: https://console.redwood/releases/d9e7

maya: receiving spike alerts from a couple Dedicated tenants ~8m ago. thanks for the quick patch. :pray:

ravi: what's changed? any risk to tail latency?

devops: tiny change to idle connection reclaim and an event-loop stall guard. no schema/runtime flags. perf runs show small CPU uptick, lower accept-timeout traces.

ops-lead: setting rollback gates before promote: rollback if errors > 1.6% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 1.1s for 5m OR instance_restarts >= 2 in 10m. Manual rollback allowed on customer 5xx spikes.

release-manager: approvals needed: ops-lead + devops + oncall. i'll hold release note until approvals are present.

oncall-zoe: i'm on pager and will monitor dashboards. +1 from oncall.

devops: +1 after quick code review. artifact diffs minimal.

ops-lead: +1. expedite ok but keep manual promote steps.

devops: kicking canary now:
```
/deploy canary --svc pool-guard --image registry.redwood/inference/pool-guard:hotfix-2026-03-24-d9e7 --canary 5% --monitor 10m
```

deploy-bot automated update 3298887790: canary metrics snapshot: errors 0.7%, p95 720ms, qps 390, restarts 0

maya: logs show fewer "accept timeout" traces. early positive signal.

ravi: recommend ramp to 30% for 5m then 100% if steady.

ops-lead: agree. ramp to 30% then evaluate against rollback criteria.

devops: running ramp:
```
/deploy ramp --svc pool-guard --to 30% --wait 5m
```

deploy-bot automated update 3298887815: ramp snapshot: errors 0.9%, p95 800ms, restarts 0

oncall-zoe: monitoring dashboards, will call rollback at first sign of sustained breach.

release-manager: approvals are in; publishing stub release note and notifying CS. Draft: "Pool guard hotfix: connection reclaim tuning to reduce stalled requests in dedicated pools. Rolling now."

devops: criteria met to proceed to full rollout. executing promote:
```
/deploy promote --svc pool-guard --to 100%
```

deploy-bot automated update 3298887830: rollout complete. final metrics: errors 0.5%, p95 670ms, restarts 0. All green.

ops-lead: nice work. keep rollback playbook available for 30m post-deploy watch.

maya: thanks team — i'll file a short post-deploy blameless note and ping impacted customer accounts. :thumbsup:
